chunks: He cemented together their hearts; if you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have united their hearts, but Allah united them. Indeed, He is Almighty, Wise.
ai.seo_question: How did Allah unite the hearts of the believers when human effort failed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate that true cohesion (mu'allafat al-qulub) among the believers stems from divine grace rather than human strategy or wealth, a principle central to the Imam's role in unifying the community. It underscores that while material means are necessary, they are insufficient without Allah's will, highlighting the interplay between human effort and divine facilitation in establishing social harmony.
